Checks.Name: CK_IedDevice_FirmwareModel
Checks.Definition: ([FirmwareId] IS NULL OR [DeviceModelId] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: CK_Scope_Target
Checks.Definition: ([Kind]=N'Corporation' AND [CorporationId] IS NOT NULL AND [ManagementUnitId] IS NULL AND [StationId] IS NULL OR [Kind]=N'ManagementUnit' AND [CorporationId] IS NULL AND [ManagementUnitId] IS NOT NULL AND [StationId] IS NULL OR [Kind]=N'Station' AND [CorporationId] IS NULL AND [ManagementUnitId] IS NULL AND [StationId] IS NOT NULL)

Checks.Name: CK_MfaCredential_Material
Checks.Definition: ([Kind]=N'WebAuthn' AND [PublicKey] IS NOT NULL AND [EncryptedSecret] IS NULL OR [Kind]=N'Totp' AND [EncryptedSecret] IS NOT NULL AND [KeyVersion] IS NOT NULL AND [PublicKey] IS NULL)

Checks.Name: CK_DisturbanceRecord_State
Checks.Definition: ([State]='Retained' OR [State]='Failed' OR [State]='Processed' OR [State]='Processing' OR [State]='Quarantined' OR [State]='Validated' OR [State]='MetadataAccepted')

Checks.Name: CK_RecordFile_File
Checks.Definition: ([SizeBytes]>=(0) AND ([Extension]='.inf' OR [Extension]='.hdr' OR [Extension]='.dat' OR [Extension]='.cfg') AND ([ValidationStatus]='Rejected' OR [ValidationStatus]='Verified' OR [ValidationStatus]='Pending') AND NOT [Name] like '%/%' AND NOT [Name] like '%\%' AND NOT [Name] like '%:%')

Checks.Name: CK_RecordFile_ObjectKey
Checks.Definition: (NOT [StorageObjectKey] like '%..%' AND NOT [StorageObjectKey] like '%:%' AND left([StorageObjectKey],(1))<>'/' AND NOT [StorageObjectKey] like '%\%')

Checks.Name: CK_AnalysisResult_Json
Checks.Definition: (([ResultJson] IS NULL OR isjson([ResultJson])=(1)) AND ([Status]<>'NotImplemented' OR [ResultJson] IS NULL))

Checks.Name: CK_ProcessingOutbox_Queue
Checks.Definition: ([Attempts]>=(0) AND ([State]='Failed' OR [State]='Completed' OR [State]='Leased' OR [State]='Pending') AND ([LeaseUntilUtc] IS NULL AND [LeaseOwner] IS NULL OR [LeaseUntilUtc] IS NOT NULL AND [LeaseOwner] IS NOT NULL))

Checks.Name: CK_StationSoeEvent_Range
Checks.Definition: (([Sequence] IS NULL OR [Sequence]>=(0) AND [Sequence]<=(65535)) AND ([SubSequence] IS NULL OR [SubSequence]>=(0) AND [SubSequence]<=(65535)) AND ([ConfRev] IS NULL OR [ConfRev]>=(0) AND [ConfRev]<=(4294967295.)))
